description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the DataGroupDao data access object within the OrangeHRM system. It tests various methods related to data groups, such as retrieving permissions and data group entities, and handles setup and teardown of test data.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing DataGroupDao methods related to data groups and permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, truncates specific tables, and populates test data before each test method runs.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Tests that permissions for a specific data group are retrieved correctly, verifying count and permission values.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Verifies that the total number of data groups retrieved matches the expected number.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupsNoneDefined
methods.description: Ensures that when the data group table is emptied, the retrieval method returns zero data groups.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Checks that specific data groups can be retrieved correctly and are instances of DataGroup.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupInvalid
methods.description: Verifies that requesting a non-existent data group returns null.
